header" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" HNSW Vector Search (k=6 semantic match)<br>- Deduplicate candidate chunk IDs in RAM<br>- Single batched SQLite fetch: getChunksByIds(ids)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;fontColor=#4c1d95;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="100" truncate tail of prompt<br>- Preserves JSON schema instructions & assistant role turn" width="340" height="105" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s4" value="Step 4: Local LLM Generation<br>- LlamaEngine (Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct GGUF)<br>- Accelerated by NVIDIA CUDA or Intel MKL AVX2<br>- Autoregressive JSON completion generation" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcfce7;strokeColor=#15803d;fontColor=#14532d;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1180" y="100" width="320" height="105" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s5" value="Step 5: Multi-Pass JSON Sanitizer (autoRepairJson)<br>- Strips markdown code fences (```json ... ```)<br>- Repairs syntax errors inside non-string tokens:<br> &bull; ': ,' &rarr; ': null,'<br> &bull; ': -' &rarr; ': null,' (dashes in table cells)<br> &bull; ': N/A' &rarr; ': null,'<br> &bull; Dangling colons: '"key":' &rarr; '"key": null'<br> &bull; Balances open braces and brackets stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fee2e2;strokeColor=#dc2626;fontColor=#7f1d1d;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1180" y="260" width="320" height="140" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s6" value="Step 6: Regex Fallback Harvester (parseOrRecoverJson)<br>- If standard nlohmann::json parse fails:<br>- Scans raw buffer with resilient regex for all valid key-value pairs:<br> &bull; Numeric values, strings, booleans, and sub-arrays<br>- Salvages extracted metrics without dropping the section" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffedd5;strokeColor=#ea580c;fontColor=#7c2d12;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="260" width="340" height="140" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s7" value="Step 7: Persistence & FactStore Update<br>- Saves cleaned section JSON to SQLite (report_sections)<br>- Updates FactStore with newly discovered base facts<br>- Records source page provenance for auditability" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ecfdf5;strokeColor=#059669;fontColor=#064e3b;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="275" width="360" height="110" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s8" value="Step 8: Consultant Review & Verification<br>- Qt Quick Desktop Client (ReportReviewScreen)<br>- Scalar Metrics: 2-column form grid with human SEBI titles<br>- Tabular Loops: Spreadsheet-style data grid (LoopFieldEditor)<br>- Inline cell editing, [+ Add Row], [✕ Delete]<br>- Collapsible missing-field warning badges" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e0f2fe;strokeColor=#0284c7;fontColor=#0c4a6e;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="450" width="480" height="130" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s9" value="Step 9: Report Acceptance & Export<br>- Consultant clicks [Accept & Lock]<br>- Status set to 'ACCEPTED' in database<br>- Inja svg.text: Carbon Engine — Targeted Statutory Extraction & Recovery Pipeline
Two-Tier Scoped RAG | FactStore Memoization | Context Budget Guard | Multi-Pass JSON Sanitizer
• Tier A: Page Locality Window (±2 chunks on anchor page)
• Tier B: FAISS HNSW Vector Search (k=6 semantic match)
• Deduplicate candidate chunk IDs in RAM
• Hard limit context to 2,400 tokens / 9,000 chars
• Middle-Out Trimming: Never truncate prompt tail
• Preserves JSON schema instructions and assistant
role turn to prevent malformed completion
• Accelerated by NVIDIA CUDA or Intel MKL AVX2
- Balances unclosed braces and brackets stack
- Triggers if standard nlohmann::json parse fails
- Scans raw buffer with resilient regex for all valid
- Salvages extracted metrics without discarding section
• Saves cleaned section JSON to SQLite (report_sections)
• Updates FactStore with newly discovered base facts
• Records source page provenance for auditability
• Scalar Metrics: 2-column form grid with human SEBI titles
• In-place cell editing, [+ Add Row], and [✕ Delete] controls
• Inja merges verified JSON into template.html
• Exports responsive offline HTML / PDF with Chart.js analytics
